Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, SQL • Frontend: React.js, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Redux, Responsive UI Development, • Backend: Node.js, Express.js, FastAPI, Flask, REST APIs, Microservices, Event-Driven Systems, Redis • Cloud & DevOps:: AWS(Lambda, EC2, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, SQS, Bedrock, Sagemaker), Docker, Kubernetes, Serverless Architecture, Azure AD

raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer @ Trianz Hyderabad
August 2023 - Present
Architected and developed scalable event-driven backend systems using AWS Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, and Node.js, supporting concurrent real-time AI voice interactions with dynamic workload management.
Built production-grade full-stack applications using React, JavaScript, TypeScript, and REST APIs, improving user engagement and reducing operational overhead through automation.
Designed distributed microservices and serverless workflows for CRM and lead management platforms, enabling real-time data processing and intelligent routing.
Developed highly scalable RAG-based document intelligence systems capable of semantic retrieval across large datasets with low- latency responses and optimized indexing strategies.
Implemented secure authentication and authorization systems using JWT, AWS Cognito and Azure AD SSO for enterprise and government-grade applications.
Developed modular Python-based AI orchestration services using FastAPI and LangGraph for autonomous workflow execution. • Led technical architecture discussions, system design decisions, and end-to-end feature delivery across multiple production applica- tions.
Mentored team members on scalable backend architecture, serverless design patterns, and frontend integration best practices. • Built scalable Python microservices for RAG pipelines, semantic search, and LLM-powered business automation. • Containerized AI services using Docker and integrated deployment pipelines for scalable cloud-native environments.
raw_sections.projects:
PROJECTS
Led development of a secure full-stack web platform for US government digital evidence management using React, AWS S3, Lambda, Cognito, and Azure AD SSO.
Designed scalable access-control workflows and federated authentication systems supporting secure multi-agency collaboration and compliance requirements.
Owned architecture planning, sprint execution, stakeholder communication, and production delivery lifecycle.
ACHIVEMENTS
Built a scalable full-stack recruitment platform using React, Node.js, and TypeScript featuring automated resume analysis, real-time interview evaluation, and intelligent candidate matching.
• Developed responsive frontend interfaces and backend APIs supporting concurrent recruiter workflows and low-latency candidate
